True from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1)
    hr = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == sep]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rbounds = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rbounds, rbounds[1:]):
        rowout = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cbounds, cbounds[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep
                    for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb))
            rowout.append(1 if n >= 2 else bg)
        out.append(rowout)
    return out
